context:
Source-map first (w1): walk the bundle schema and write down exactly which
bundle key maps to which manifest field. Avoids guessing during implementation.

Compute geomean_ms at transform time, not in the browser. The browser DuckDB
can do it in a query, but pre-computing it means it's available in the JSON
manifest and in sort/filter without DuckDB being loaded.

tuning_hash: short SHA256 prefix of the serialized tuning config dict (or
tuning mode string if no detail is available). Purpose is grouping, not
cryptographic identity - 8 hex chars is enough.

test_type: infer from which phases are present in the bundle. If
phases.power_test is populated → "power"; if phases.throughput_test → "throughput";
if both → "power" (primary). If neither, leave null.
description:
Post-launch audit (2026-04-14) found that the Phase 1 pipeline transformer
emits only 11 manifest fields from a bundle that contains 13 blocks and
50+ fields. This silently drops execution_mode, tuning_mode, platform_version,
test_type, validation_status, cost_usd, and the per-query run_type/iter/stream
fields needed for warmup vs measurement distinction.

The DuckDB `results` table has 11 columns; all other fidelity TODOs
(methodology disclosure, tuning visibility, comparability warnings, charts)
depend on these fields reaching the manifest and DuckDB schema first.

Target manifest additions (all sourced from existing bundle fields):
  - geomean_ms          - exp(mean(ln(query_ms))) across measurement queries
  - execution_mode      - "sql" | "dataframe" from config.mode
  - tuning_mode         - "tuned" | "notuning" | "auto" from config.tuning_mode
  - tuning_hash         - stable short hash of tuning config for grouping
  - platform_version    - platform.version (distinct from driver_version)
  - test_type           - "power" | "throughput" from phases
  - validation_status   - summary.validation.status
  - cost_usd            - cost.total_usd (null if absent)

Target query record additions:
  - run_type            - "warmup" | "measurement" per query timing entry
  - iter, stream        - iteration and stream IDs

Explorer pages render correctly for bundles that have no tuning config, no cost data, or no run_type on queries
Null-safety for older bundles that predate any new field - missing → null, not error

work_units.summary: Audit transformer.py and models.py: map each target field to its bundle source path; document any fields that require computation (geomean_ms, tuning_hash) vs direct extraction.
Add geomean_ms computation to transformer.py: exp(mean(ln(ms))) over measurement-only queries (run_type=measurement or all if run_type absent). Add to ManifestResult and DetailResult models.
Add execution_mode, tuning_mode, tuning_hash, platform_version, test_type, validation_status, cost_usd to ManifestResult and DetailResult. Null-safe for older bundles.
Add run_type, iter, stream to QueryTiming in detail JSON. Update transformer.py query extraction loop.
Extend DuckDB schema in duckdb_builder.py: add all new manifest columns to the results table; add run_type, iter, stream columns to queries table. Regenerate for existing corpus and verify.
Update TypeScript types.ts in results-explorer to match extended ManifestResult and DetailResult shapes. No UI changes - just type alignment.
Re-run full pipeline over existing corpus; confirm no regressions in existing explorer pages; confirm new fields appear in manifest and DuckDB.
